scope: Four legacy manuscript phase-envelope replacements, separate from the 104 notebook plots and NIST plot audit.

summary.physical_scope: Three transition brackets per branch per fluid, component conservation, positive phase density, normalized compositions and two-phase fugacity equality. No independent laboratory validation or critical-point claim.

records.finding: Axes and units, branch legend, sampled extrema, qualified VLE-only footer and retained continuation gaps are clear. No fabricated critical point or operating trajectory is shown.
